latestVersion.changelog:
video-speed-changer 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and adjust video speed with simple text instructions.
- Automatic backend connection, with free anonymous tokens if no NEMO_TOKEN is set.
- Supports exporting edited videos in 1080p MP4 format.
- Built for fast editing by YouTubers, TikTok creators, and educators—no complex tools required.
- Provides clear workflow guidance, status updates, and robust error handling.
